anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Broad, shallow convex spline with a large radius defining the anterior-dorsal forehead boundary.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, triangular projection with a tapering thickness and a pixel length approximately equal to the melon-to-rostrum base width.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Measured obtuse angle of approximately 145 degrees at the pixel transition from the melon curvature to the dorsal rostrum line.

other_distinctive_markers: Specimen exhibits a high-intensity cyan-teal pixel distribution with high-luminance longitudinal banding along the dorsal flank and a concentrated ocular glow.
